chunks: Have they not journeyed in the land and seen how the end of those before them, who were far more powerful, came about? There is nothing in the heavens and the earth that can defeat (the law of) God. He is all-knowing and all-powerful.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about observing the fate of previous nations?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as a foundational principle for 'historical reflection' (ta'ammul), urging believers to analyze the causal links between moral decay and divine punishment in past civilizations. It highlights that God's power (Qudrah) is absolute and not constrained by the strength or resources of any nation, reinforcing the concept of divine justice (Adl) where the mighty are humbled by their own hubris.
